metadata.title: त्रिपुरा में विलेज काउंसिल चुनाव क्यों ज़रूरी | Delayed Village Council Election in Tripura
metadata.description: In the northeastern state of Tripura, India, one-third of the population belongs to various tribal communities. The Constitution of India recognizes the significance of tribal areas and has implemented special provisions to protect their rights and promote their development. One of these provisions entails the establishment of village councils, which serve as local governing bodies. These councils play a vital role in ensuring community participation, decision-making, and overall development. However, the scheduled village council elections for 2021 have been delayed, despite orders from the High Court to hold the elections. In this ground report, we delve into the consequences of the government's lack of action and examine how this delay hampers the development of tribal areas in Tripura.
